name: RepeatingSectionItemColl
description: Represents the collection of RepeatingSectionItem objects.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified RepeatingSectionItemColl object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of repeating section items in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual repeating section item.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the item in the collection.
